dependencies: NTA-published static question paper plus final key for each selected exam-date/subject family, or a candidate-authorized export with provenance and permission to retain/use internally.

For any third-party mirror: written reuse permission from the rights-holder, then per-item authentication by exact official question ID and option ID/number against the NTA final key; record paper date, booklet/sequence locator, original exam locator, URL, file hash, permission scope, and any key corrections.
Maintain source-family-disjoint four-subject development, regression, and release sets; new keys alone cannot supply missing question text.
